limitations: No report or metric was recomputed. Existing failed, corrected and superseded outputs stay in place.
Physical attempts, shared reports, source aliases and common prefixes are not independent extra samples. Their costs must not be summed blindly.
File hashes identify preserved artifacts at review time; they do not create execution provenance.
shared_evidence_note: The same preserved report/figure can be linked from several E records. Such a link neither transfers producer ownership nor creates a distinct analysis execution or independent sample.
